name: Comparison Area
description: This period as a water area over the last as a dashed line, in a card with the comparison in the tooltip.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per point along the bottom.

props.name: current
props.description: This period's values, drawn as a water area.

props.name: previous
props.description: The comparison period's values, drawn as a dashed line.

props.name: currentName
props.description: Name of the current period in the legend and tooltip.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes values in the tooltip. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: formatAxis
props.description: Writes the tick labels on the left. Defaults to compact numbers.

props.name: titles
props.description: Longer names for the tooltip title.

props.name: xLabel
props.description: A title under the horizontal axis. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: yLabel
props.description: A title beside the vertical axis, set sideways. The chart makes room for it.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated when left out.

props.name: action
props.description: Replaces the legend at the top right.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: note
props.description: A muted line under the value, e.g. last year's total.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Also accepts caption, footer, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
